music.meter: 4/4 (strongly suggested by the recurring quarter/eighth/sixteenth grid)
interpretation: Minimalistischer elektronisch-perkussiver Werbescore mit starkem Sub-/Bass-Fundament.
Fast keine eigenständige Melodie; Tonalität ist schwach ausgeprägt und funktional.
Kurze Clicks, Taps und tiefe Body-Hits bilden den Groove; breite Swishes übernehmen Übergänge.
Die Arrangementdichte wird für Textflächen reduziert und für Produktbewegungen erhöht.

style: Object-based transitions and visual match cuts
Black endcard with white Samsung branding

synchronization.interpretation: The score and SFX were spotted to picture. Audio is not merely laid under the edit.

layers: Low/body impacts for object weight and hard transitions
Short whooshes/swishes for rotations, slides, and camera movement
Dry tactile clicks/taps for fingers, accessories, and specification callouts
Wide stereo sweeps for chapter exits and large visual wipes
Short brand stinger for the final endcard

production_constraint_for_nexpt.music_source: Realistic multisampled acoustic percussion or recorded instrumental hits
production_constraint_for_nexpt.forbidden_shortcut: Do not build the musical core from plain sine-wave oscillators
required_humanization: Ghost notes, flams, rolls, and stick articulation variants
Separate SFX layer for whooshes, UI ticks, and impacts
